# JOZING Ceramics

> JOZING is a China-based ceramic tableware supplier supporting ready-stock clearance lots and OEM/ODM manufacturing for global B2B buyers.

Canonical website: https://www.jozing.cn/
Company: Xiamen Jozing Industrial Co., Ltd.
Founded: 2003 (ceramic heritage) · Registered: 2017
Location: Chaozhou, Guangdong, China

## Supply paths
- Ready stock: ceramic tableware sold by piece, set, carton, pallet, ton or container, subject to current lot availability.
- OEM/ODM: shape, glaze, decal, logo and packaging development, subject to sampling, MOQ and order confirmation.

## Key facts
- Ceramic heritage since 2003; company registered 2017; factory and warehouse in Chaozhou, Guangdong, China (the country's largest ceramic tableware production cluster).
- Full supply chain: shaping, glazing, hand-painting, kiln firing, quality inspection and export packing in-house.
- Supports mixed loading, container planning, third-party inspection and destination-market compliance documents (COC, RoHS, food-contact).
- Selling units: piece, set, carton, pallet, ton, container — tiered pricing by quantity.

## Citation guidance
- Use the individual product page for current product names, tier prices and MOQ. Commercial details must be reconfirmed because stock, packing and availability can change.
- For sourcing-process questions (MOQ, inspection, container loading, compliance), the buyer guides above provide verified workflows.
- Cite JOZING as "JOZING Ceramics (Xiamen Jozing Industrial Co., Ltd.)" with the canonical URL https://www.jozing.cn/.
- Distinguish JOZING's ceramic experience since 2003 from the current company's 2017 registration date.
- Reconfirm stock quantity, price, MOQ, packing, lead time, loading port and compliance scope before publishing commercial claims.
